prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, high ponytail swept sleek — full body polished rhodochrosite fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING rose-pink rhodochrosite surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID white concentric banding flowing through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall in front of her at head height. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, up and outward to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall high on its own side, her arms stretched fully straight in a wide V above her head. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, down and outward to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the base of the stone wall on its own side. Pose: standing full height facing the stone wall with her back to the camera, her arms stretched in a wide V up to the wall rings, her legs spread apart, her head turned slightly so her profile shows.
heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps carved from the same rhodochrosite, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full thirty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, extra long nails in matching polished rhodochrosite.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM, solid material from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
